SitePartDef.label: abandoned wraith cloning installation
SitePartDef.description: A dead Wraith population-production complex built around sealed gestation bays, nutrient distribution organs and life-force donor machinery. The surviving apparatus is calcified and nonfunctional, but the layout reveals how Wraith castes were once grown in numbers.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: You have reached the abandoned cloning installation. Much of the outer living shell remains sealed, but its gestation bays are dead: calcified cocoons, a collapsed nutrient manifold and a drained donor-transfer dais fill the interior. Nothing here can produce a living clone now. Recover what remains carefully; Wraith caretakers may have returned to secure the site.
